title: Third Place Winners in Southwest AAU Tourney
text:
Third Place Winners in Southwest AAU Tourney

Shown above is the Savoy girls' basketball team, which was eliminated in the semi-finals of the Southwestern AAU cage tournament at Celeste. Prior to their entry in the AAU tournament they were undefeated in 34 games this year, and lost only one contest last season by a one-point margin. Shown in the picture, from left to right, standing: Johnnie B. Wood, Ola Lea Hutchins, Billy Brown, Tiny Bibby, Joyce Sharp, Mary Lou Carruth, Tommie Smith and Irva Fae Miller. Front row, kneeling: Lena Fay Winkler, Coach Joe Lynn Dodson and Peggy O'Neal.
notes: Group photo of Savoy girls' basketball team. Team undefeated in 34 games. Third place in Southwestern AAU tournament at Celeste.
